thread:
Marissa Cole: hey all — for SCM / Console cost breakdown launch: can we sync on launch comms + internal enablement? Need a staged availability plan (who gets it when), plus screenshots for enablement decks. Want to get ahead of Support questions re: “estimated” + assumptions/confidence.

Talia Benson: +1. I’m putting together the rollout brief for exec update. Can folks reply w/ (a) proposed rollout phases + gating criteria and (b) who owns comms artifacts? We should align w/ Release train timing.

Aditya Rao: Optimize side: we’ll need a short internal note explaining what SCM is/what it isn’t (not billing, technical estimate + attribution). Also we should add a blurb on how Optimize uses SCM “what-if” so CS doesn’t oversell precision.

Dylan Brooks: Console UI is basically ready behind flag. I can grab screenshots from staging once the copy is final (tooltips for assumptions + “low confidence” badge state). Any preference on where to store? gdrive folder?

Elliot Price: Docs can host an internal “Launch kit” page (Confluence) with: overview, FAQ, known limitations, sample payload, and screenshot gallery. If someone drops final strings/copy and the staged plan I’ll assemble.

Marissa Cole: perfect. Dylan can you capture:
- cost breakdown table (compute/memory/cache)
- empty state when SCM unavailable
- low confidence callout + tooltip
- “Explain” details drawer (if we have it)

Chloe Martin: explain drawer is in progress but we can screenshot the basic breakdown + assumptions panel today. The “explain endpoint” output is wired in staging, but we’re still trimming payload size. Expect stable by end of week.

Connor O'Brien: for staged availability: we’ll probably do 3 steps in release train.
1) internal only (dogfood tenants) -> 1-2 days
2) canary on small % of Hosted API tenants + 1 Dedicated pilot -> 2-3 days
3) beta opt-in for enterprise tenants (support-enabled) -> ~1 week
Then GA once SLOs look good.
Need explicit go/no-go gates and rollback switch names.

Benji Okafor: flags:
- `scm_cost_breakdown_enabled` (Console)
- `scm_api_client_enabled` (Console backend)
- `cost_model_service_enabled` (platform) already exists
We can gate by tenant + environment. Also can do per-region if needed.

Sean Gallagher: SRE asks: include in staged plan that Console must degrade gracefully if SCM is slow/unavailable. We saw in staging that timeouts can impact page load if retries aren’t capped. For GA gate, I’d like: p95 < 150ms (service), error rate < 0.5%, and Console fallback rate < 2% (meaning it didn’t show breakdown) for 48h.

Rafael Mendes: + add canary check results (estimate vs metered drift on fixed prompt set). We already have perf-canary job; we should make “drift < X%” part of GA gate. The alert is a little noisy right now but manageable.

Naomi Feldman: please call out in enablement that this is customer-sensitive in some contexts. Support should not paste raw breakdowns into public tickets; use secure channel + redact tenant ids in screenshots.

Marissa Cole: good call. We’ll add a “handling guidance” section.
Also: comms — I’m thinking:
- internal Slack post in #gtm and #support (what’s new, how to answer FAQ)
- short release note in Console changelog (once GA)
- CS enablement doc + 5-min Loom walkthrough

Aditya Rao: can we include explicit wording: “Estimated cost (SCM)” and “Not used for invoices” in the enablement FAQ? We’ve had customers conflate the two.

Talia Benson: yes. I’ll draft a single source-of-truth paragraph and circulate for review. Need reviewers: Marissa + Aditya + Sean + Naomi.

Dylan Brooks: re screenshots: I’ll drop in `Shared Drives/engineering/console-and-tooling/SCM-launch-assets/` by EOD. Will include both light/dark theme. Also will annotate which states are behind which flags.

Chloe Martin: staged availability plan detail: for step 2 canary, we can start with tenants that already opted into cost transparency beta (list exists). We should avoid the high-traffic ones until we confirm caching behavior.

Connor O'Brien: what’s the target date for step 1? If we want in next train, freeze is Wed 5pm PT.

Talia Benson: target: internal dogfood starting Monday, canary mid-week, beta opt-in end of week (assuming SLOs). I’ll put dates as “tentative pending gates”.

Sean Gallagher: :thumbsup: add explicit rollback: if p99 > 800ms for 15m OR Console error rate spikes, auto-disable `scm_api_client_enabled`.

Benji Okafor: we can wire that into our flag automation (same pattern as rollouts). I’ll confirm with platform oncall.

Elliot Price: once screenshots land + final staged plan bullets, I’ll publish the Launch kit page and link it back here. Also need final naming conventions for components shown in UI (Compute / Memory / Cache) so docs match.

Marissa Cole: awesome. action items:
- Dylan: screenshots to gdrive (EOD)
- Talia: staged availability plan + comms draft (tomorrow)
- Elliot: internal launch kit page (after screenshots)
- Sean/Rafael: GA gate metrics + drift threshold proposal (tomorrow)
Thanks all. :rocket:
